# Yahoo Finance

> > Yahoo Finance provides real-time stock quotes, financial news, market data, and investment analysis for Wall Street and global financial markets.

Yahoo Finance is a leading financial media platform offering comprehensive coverage of stocks, commodities, indices, and market trends. The site features real-time quotes for companies like NVIDIA, Nokia, Nu Holdings, and Intel, along with market screeners, trading volume data, and breaking financial news from Wall Street and global exchanges including Nasdaq and NYSE.

## Key Topics

- Stock quotes and real-time market data
- Trading volume and most active stocks
- Trending stocks by market interest
- Wall Street and financial market news
- Stock screeners and market analysis
- Nasdaq and NYSE listings
- Commodities and futures (Gold, etc.)
- Investment news and financial headlines
- Tech stocks (NVIDIA, Intel, UiPath)
- Fintech companies (Nu Holdings, SoFi)
- Electric vehicles and emerging markets (NIO)
- Market rankings and stock performance
- Financial securities and derivatives
- Healthcare and biotech stocks (Hims & Hers, Plug Power)

## Market Data & Stock Screeners

- [Most Active Stocks](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/most-active/): US stocks with highest trading volume featuring NVIDIA, Nokia, and others
- [Top Trending Stocks](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/trending/): Trending US stocks by interest including Airbnb, MercadoLibre, Bumble

## Stock Quotes & Company Data

- [Nu Holdings Ltd. (NU) Stock Quote](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NU/): Nu Holdings stock quote with price, history, and fintech news (NYSE)
- [Gold Futures (GC=F) Quote](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/GC=F/): Gold futures (COMEX) quote with real-time prices and commodity data

## Financial News & Analysis

- [Finance News](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/): Financial news covering Wall Street, markets, stocks, and securities
